notes: IKEA Japan (jp/ja market). Access: tier-1 direct HTTP fetch throughout, no blocks. Homepage's /offers/ (お買い得商品/Deals) landing page is a marketing hub, not itself a PLP -- it links out to several concepts: (1) IKEA Family member time-limited deals -- page copy states outright 'セール商品は期間限定です' ('Sale items are time-limited'), i.e. a temporary promotional campaign, correctly EXCLUDED as Clearance per the Sale-vs-Clearance test; (2) an in-store-only outlet reservation program ('欲しいアウトレット商品を取り置きする' / reserve an outlet item online, pick up in a physical store within 48 hours) -- no online product listing exists for this, it's a store-pickup workflow, correctly EXCLUDED (no PLP); (3) 'もうすぐ販売終了、お早めに！' (roughly 'Ending soon -- get it while you can') linking to https://www.ikea.com/jp/ja/cat/last-chance/ -- this is IKEA's standing 'Last Chance' category (same global IKEA concept as the UK/DE/FR/AE siblings' Last Chance listings), which the brief's target-term list explicitly names ('Last Chance'/'End of Line'/'Discontinued merchandised as clearance'). Verified this is a genuine permanent taxonomy node, not a campaign: embedded hierarchyObjs/JSON shows type:'cat' with subCategories:[] (a real top-level category, flat, no sub-structure), and on-page copy explains it lists soon-to-be-discontinued stock at reduced prices rather than a seasonal promotion. The homepage link appends a '?filters=f-special-price:true' query string (an additional 'price-reduced only' filter); confirmed by diffing two fetches (with vs without that filter param) that the SSR-rendered item count is identical (897 both times) -- the filter is applied client-side post-hydration, so the canonical unfiltered URL https://www.ikea.com/jp/ja/cat/last-chance/ (confirmed via <link rel=canonical>) already represents the full listing and is used as the row's link, not the filtered query string. Qty verified two ways: rendered ARIA text '897アイテム' and embedded JSON 'totalCount':897, matching on both the filtered and unfiltered fetch. No ambiguity -- not flagged as MANUAL REVIEW since the site's own copy and taxonomy placement (not a temporary sale) are both unambiguous.
